info.title: Miroir Backend API
info.description: Backend-only MVP slice: demo identity, strategy confirmation/versioning, manual trades/evidence, deterministic reviews, stats and progress.

post.summary: Create an isolated demo identity and bearer token

patch.summary: Update a strategy draft (does not change confirmed versions)

post.summary: Confirm the current draft as a new immutable strategy version
Record a manual trade (open or closed) with optional evidence
Close an open trade and compute realized P&L
Parse and validate the fixed-template trade CSV without creating trades
Commit every row in a validated preview as one atomic import
Create or return the idempotent deterministic review for a trade

get.summary: List saved reviews for a trade
Classic stats for closed realized trades in one currency
